note: Approximate outing forecast, not a personal exposure or risk estimate.

profileMessages.belowThresholdHeadline: No covered forecast period reaches UV Index 3.
profileMessages.elevatedHeadline: UV Index 3 or above appears in about {duration} of the covered forecast.
profileMessages.explanation: The overall reading considers time in each UV range and uninterrupted higher-UV periods, not just the maximum. It is an approximate forecast profile, not a personal exposure estimate.
profileMessages.lowUvContext: The covered forecast stays below UV Index 3, the usual threshold for sun-protection advice. This does not mean zero UV; reflective surroundings and personal circumstances are not included.
profileMessages.reflectiveConditions: If your outing includes snow, bright sand, or water, reflected UV can add exposure beyond what this location forecast represents.
profileMessages.sunscreenAfterConditions: If you use sunscreen, follow its product directions and reapply after swimming, sweating, or drying off.
profileMessages.moderateAction: During covered periods forecast at UV Index 3–below 8 (about {duration}), plan protection for exposed skin and eyes. Covering clothing, available shade, a hat, and UV-protective sunglasses add protection; use sunscreen on skin left uncovered.
profileMessages.veryHighAction: About {duration} of the covered forecast is at UV Index 8 or above. Give that period extra attention: use available shade, covering clothing, a hat, UV-protective sunglasses, and sunscreen on uncovered skin.
profileMessages.average: Duration-weighted average across covered forecast hours: {averageUv}.
profileMessages.longestElevated: The longest continuous period at UV Index 3 or above is about {duration}.
profileMessages.longestVeryHigh: The longest continuous period at UV Index 8 or above is about {duration}.

messages.coverageIncomplete: The forecast covers about {coveredDuration} of this {plannedDuration} outing. Conditions during the uncovered part are unknown.
messages.reapplication: This outing lasts at least two hours. If you use sunscreen, plan to reapply during it and follow the product directions.
